'''Ape Atoll Teleport''' teleports the caster to the inside entrance of the [[Ape Atoll Dungeon]], a safe location.

Completion of the [[Monkey Madness I]] [[quest]] is required to cast this spell. Neither the post-quest 10th squad training from [[Daero]] nor [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing King Awowogei|Freeing King Awowogei]] [[Recipe for Disaster]] subquest need to be completed.
